tools.name: git
tools.why: repo-state.sh (used by go and handoff) and the SessionStart hint read branch, upstream, worktree and dirty-file facts from git

tools.name: perl
tools.why: repo-state.sh bounds gh calls and .local/state-checks.sh with a perl alarm timeout (no GNU timeout on macOS)

tools.name: python3
tools.why: repo-state.sh and the SessionStart hint parse JSON with python3; without it open-PR and CI details are omitted, and the SessionStart hint and the title hook stay silent

tools.name: gh
tools.why: repo-state.sh reports open PRs and main CI status for go and handoff; without gh it reports GITHUB: unavailable

tools.name: agentbus
tools.why: inter-agent communication mechanism (such as agentbus or agentmesh): handoff routes memories to it and parks the session at session end so only direct messages wake it; without one, memories route to CLAUDE.md and the step is skipped

tools.name: agentmesh
tools.why: inter-agent communication mechanism (such as agentbus or agentmesh): handoff routes memories to it and parks the session at session end so only direct messages wake it; without one, memories route to CLAUDE.md and the step is skipped

auth.name: GitHub (gh)
auth.why: repo-state.sh needs an authenticated gh to list open PRs and CI runs; without it go and handoff mark those facts unverified
